(Published in The Topeka Metro News on July 20, 2026)
ORDINANCE NO. 20669
AN ORDINANCE INTRODUCED BY CITY MANAGER DR. ROBERT PEREZ
TERMINATING THE COLLEGE HILL REDEVELOPMENT DISTRICT
CREATED PURSUANT TO ORDINANCE NO. 18566.
WHEREAS, the City of Topeka Kansas (the “City”), is a city of the first-class organized and
existing under the constitution and laws of the State of Kansas; and
WHEREAS, the City created a Redevelopment District pursuant to K.S.A. 12-1770 et seq., as
amended (the “Act”) and Ordinance No. 18566 for the real property legally described on Exhibit A attached
hereto (the “College Hill Redevelopment District”); and
WHEREAS, all project plans for the College Hill Redevelopment District have been substantially
completed; and
WHEREAS, the City has determined that it is necessary and desirable to pass this Ordinance to
terminate the College Hill Redevelopment District and tax increment financing for the College Hill
Redevelopment District effective upon publication of this Ordinance or a summary thereof.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF TOPEKA, KANSAS, AS FOLLOWS:
Section 1. Termination of College Hill Redevelopment District. The City hereby terminates
the College Hill Redevelopment District and terminates tax increment financing for the College Hill
Redevelopment District effective upon publication of this Ordinance.
Section 2. Further Authority. The City shall, and the officers, employees and agents of the
City are hereby authorized and directed to, take such action, expend such funds and execute such other
documents, certificates and instruments as may be necessary or desirable to carry out and comply with the
intent of this Ordinance. The City Clerk is authorized and directed to transmit a copy of this Ordinance to

the governing body, clerk, assessor and treasurer of Shawnee County, and to the governing body of Unified
School District No. 501, Shawnee County, Kansas (Topeka).
Section 3. Governing Law. This Ordinance shall be governed by and construed in
accordance with the applicable laws of the State of Kansas.
Section 4. Effective Date. This Ordinance shall take effect and be in full force from and after
its passage by the Governing Body of the City and publication in the official City newspaper.
PASSED by the Governing Body of the City on July 14, 2026, and APPROVED AND
SIGNED by the Mayor.
Spencer L. Duncan, Mayor
